changes: Close a zero-net carrier plan without inserting an invalid zero-value cash transaction.
Calculate gross, deductions and net in integer cents; validate account limits and blank carrier names.
Require an active TRY account before recording a positive carrier payout; retain existing same-plan payment replay protection.
Store carrier plan creation, audit and an actor-scoped recovery key atomically on a new mandatory-key route.
Separate finance create and approval controls; review the exact account and amount before closing a plan.
Retry the original uncertain create request, freeze other writes while unresolved, retain drafts after failure and show refresh failures separately from successful payments.
Keep historical plan data visible when an independent account read fails; use active TRY accounts for new plans.
Reject invalid or reversed reconciliation dates with a client error before database access.

verification.reproduced_before_fix: A 100 gross / 100 deduction plan raised a finance_transactions_amount_check error on mark-paid.
verification.database_scope: Actual carrier table migration and service against isolated synthetic SQL records; no live writes.

limitations: Uncertain create recovery remains in the current screen session. After a full reload, inspect the plan list before entering another plan.
manual_checks_pending: Browser review of plan confirmation and role-specific controls after deployment.
deployment_requirement: Deploy the API and panel together; new clients intentionally do not fall back to duplicate-prone legacy create routes.
